buttons.notes: Shifts the wheel between hyper-fast free-spinning and precise click-to-click scrolling. Not a DPI control despite the button previously being labeled 'DPI Shift' here.
No fixed default function; user-programmable via SetPoint/LGS.

save.reason: Legacy G500 storage has not been validated by the modern sector writer

notes: The physical order is kept distinct from G502 because there is no profile-cycle control in this mapping.

DPI maximum corrected 8200 -> 5700: libratbag's logitech-g500.device declares DpiRange=0:5700@23.53 for 0xC068. 8200 is G500s's confirmed ceiling (logitech-g500s.device, 0xC24E, DpiRange=0:8200@50), not G500's -- the two figures appear to have been conflated between the sibling files.

Corrected 2026-09-17: reduced from 10 to 9 buttons, dropping the 'Wheel tilt left/right' pair entirely and renaming 'DPI Shift' to 'Scroll wheel mode shift'. The official 94-page G500 manual's numbered overview diagram has no wheel-tilt/horizontal-scroll callout at all, and the technical-specifications page has no 'supports horizontal' field either (unlike G500s, which explicitly has both) -- the tilt pair was very likely bled in from the G500s sibling file, same shape of error as the DPI-maximum conflation above. The button previously labeled 'DPI Shift' is really the wheel's free-spin/click-to-click mode-shift button, unrelated to DPI (same function already documented on G9/G9x as 'Mode Shift Button').
